title: Development and Application of Automated Preoperative Planning System for Developmental Dysplasia of the Hip via Keypoint Selective Integration.
summary: Prospective DDH preoperative planning system uses integrated keypoint detection and planning parameters; results report keypoint detection and planning-system evaluation, with rare severe DDH cases limiting learning. It does not establish improved patient outcomes. The result is limited to this study setting and is not evidence of benefit in deployment.
